mediaBehavior.overlay: solid or translucent heritage field when copy needs contrast

rules.statement: Motion reveals hierarchy and material detail; it does not decorate every element or compete with the room and product.
Use smooth, deliberate fades, small rises, masks, and camera-like drifts with complete readable holds between transitions.
Avoid bounce, elastic overshoot, glitch, strobe, rapid spin, aggressive zoom, liquid type, or logo distortion.
Render typography and logos as crisp composited layers; do not ask synthesized footage to draw words or identity marks.
Provide a reduced-motion treatment that removes parallax, scale travel, looping, and nonessential camera movement while preserving content order and state meaning.
Use depth, material simulation, light movement, and spatial transitions sparingly to heighten craft or dimensionality, never as a technology demonstration.

For product-highlight video, use inverse white uppercase editorial primary lines with visibly generous tracking and one consistent support family across scenes. Resolve licensed and render-safe families before preview.

When inverse copy lacks contrast, first choose negative space or add a spatially soft heritage-green scrim that fades into the plate; introduce a hard card only when softer deterministic treatments cannot pass.
Transition the media plate and its scene wrapper on the same timing contract, and keep approved media declarations reconstructable so repeated assembly cannot delete, duplicate, or reorder footage.

sequence: title reveals by line or quiet mask
composition.timing: Stagger hierarchy by 100 to 180 milliseconds; preserve a full reading hold.
composition.movement: Opacity plus no more than 24 pixels of travel.

composition.background: Crop approved image or video to full bleed. Use a restrained 104-to-100 percent drift only when it reinforces depth.
sequence: copy field fades or slides no more than 48 pixels
official logo resolves as a separate crisp layer
composition.stagger: 100 to 180 milliseconds from highest to lowest hierarchy.
composition.easing: Use the brand enter curve for arrivals, standard curve for drift, and exit curve only when leaving the frame.
composition.transitions: Prefer cut, editorial crossfade, square mask, or measured slide. Match direction and visual mass across the edit.
composition.hold: Maintain a readable hold of at least 1.2 seconds.
composition.reducedMotion: Remove drift and travel; preserve ordered opacity changes and the final hold.

composition.layers: Keep product source visually authoritative; annotations and typography remain separate composited layers.

composition.background: Use approved cinematic plates full bleed and keep product visibility primary.
composition.primaryType: Use inverse white uppercase editorial lines at regular weight with 0.06em tracking.
composition.supportType: Use one consistent resolved interface support family across every scene at the motion support scale.
composition.materialField: On quiet dark material photography, prefer borderless white type and a restrained white hairline directly on the plate.
composition.contrastRepair: On pale or active footage, use negative space first, then a soft heritage-green edge-to-transparent scrim. Use a hard panel only when necessary to pass.
sequence: official brand artwork resolves on a controlled heritage field
composition.transitions: Apply the same transition timing to the media plate and scene wrapper.
composition.finalResolve: Use official supplied artwork, preserve clear space, and hold for at least 1.2 seconds.
composition.assembly: Approved media declarations must remain reconstructable and repeated assembly must preserve source count, order, and timing.
composition.reducedMotion: Remove drift and travel while preserving scene order, copy hierarchy, contrast, and final resolve.

composition.transitions: Use square crops, masks, measured slides, and editorial crossfades.
composition.depth: Optional shallow parallax or restrained dimensional planes.
composition.constraint: No more than three simultaneous visual layers.

composition.enter: Logo and invitation fade or reveal cleanly on an uncluttered field.
composition.hold: At least 1.2 seconds and longer when copy requires it.
composition.exit: Cut or gentle fade; no logo transformation.

evaluation.question: Can each text layer be read comfortably at normal playback speed?
Does every movement clarify hierarchy, product, material, or spatial relationship?
Does the reduced-motion alternative preserve meaning and task completion?
Are scale, direction, lighting, and object identity coherent across the full sequence?
Do preview and render resolve the same explicit display and support families, with licensed asset availability recorded?
Does every expected media plate remain present, playable, ordered, and synchronized after repeated assembly?
